blind.description: A stylized fantasy or dungeon wall-mounted bunk bed or bench composed of wooden planks bound by chunky iron brackets, hinges, and heavy suspension chains on either side. A rolled tan canvas or burlap mattress pad rests on the platform, accompanied by a folded brown cloth blanket or pillow. Geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures, resting directly on the ground with no separate base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden platform with a vertical backboard along the upper edge, flanked by thick iron chains at the sides, featuring a tan burlap sleeping mat and a folded dark greyish-brown square blanket on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: The bench stands roughly 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around knee height compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure) and measures approximately 3.5 to 4 feet in width.
